d.investigationBoundary: PersistentRuntimeService ownership/liveness only: accessibility disable/destroy, START_STICKY restart, notification truth, and controller connectivity. Excludes daemon-side cover lease recovery and all production writes.
d.dominantSuspectedLimitation: The START_STICKY foreground service can remain/restart and advertise Duo Open is ready after the actual FoldOverlayService continuity controller is absent.
d.knownOverlap: Prior process-recovery work discusses PersistentRuntimeService only as app-process lifetime context; its target is daemon-surviving privileged cover state, not FGS/controller liveness truth.
